reason: The hypothesis synthesizes findings from multiple distinct papers: it links grain-boundary-mediated internal oxidation from P2 with the FCC-to-BCC phase transformation mechanism from P5/P17/P25/P31, and applies this combined mechanism to a new, additively manufactured alloy with low Al content, proposing a specific microstructural intervention (grain coarsening) to test the link. None of the passages propose this integrated degradation pathway or the specific test for the given alloy.
copied_elements: chromia and alumina as predominant oxides (P2)
FCC to BCC phase transformation under stress/corrosion (P5, P17, P25, P31)
